events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect score.py comment and rubric git state
events.input: $ sed -n 1,20p workshop-plan/tasks/features/score.py && git status --short -- docs/feature-rubric.md workshop-plan/tasks/features/score.py && git log --oneline -2 -- docs/feature-rubric.md && git fetch -q origin main && git branch -r --contains $(git log -1 --format=%h -- docs/feature-rubric.md) | head -2; ls workshop-plan/tasks/ | grep -i sync
